decisive_items: Well-developed cornoid lamellae with a decreased granular layer
Vacuolar degeneration of the basal cell layer
response.rationale: Cornoid lamellae and individual cell dyskeratosis are hallmark features of Darier's disease, whereas Grover's disease typically shows acantholysis without cornoid lamellae. The clinical presentation of pruritic papules on extremities and lack of response to topical steroids also aligns with Darier's disease.

rejected.why: Lacks cornoid lamellae and individual cell dyskeratosis; features are nonspecific and more consistent with other papulosquamous disorders.
